title: Genomic and Functional Technologies for Studying Cancer Stem Cell Dynamics, Metastasis, and Therapy Resistance.
snippet: Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are a functionally defined and plastic subpopulation of tumor cells. While the precise definition of CSCs is still debated, studies demonstrate that CSCs are capable of driving recurrence, metastases, and therapeutic resistance.
